# MSSQL Extension for VS Code: New Getting Started Page, Agent skills, SQL Formatter, and more

## What Changed

Get started faster with common SQL workflows and resources in one place. The MSSQL extension for VS Code v1.46 introduces a new Getting Started page experience in Public Preview with quick actions, guided walkthroughs, dev container templates, and one-click installation of the latest Microsoft SQL agent skills for GitHub Copilot.
